scenario: A simple reminder request is handled with no errors.

turns.text: Remind me to take the trash out at 7pm.
Got it, I'll remind you to take the trash out at 7pm.
Thanks!
You're welcome!

expected.agent_should: Set the reminder and politely acknowledge the follow-up.

scenario: A weather request receives a duplicate webhook delivery.

turns.text: Will it rain in alex? no, generic spot? Will it rain today?
Looks like clear skies today.
duplicate webhook delivery of SMb62ed79a408f47d49ac805e724f81d05
Thanks.
No problem.

expected.agent_should: Deduplicate the incoming message and avoid sending a second reply for it.

scenario: The user opts out of SMS messages after a quick request.

turns.text: What is my grocery list for this week?
Your grocery list has eggs, milk, and bread.
STOP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent
You have been unsubscribed. Text START to resume.

expected.agent_should: Acknowledge the opt-out, stop future outbound SMS, and confirm unsubscribing.

scenario: The user requests help information for the assistant.

turns.text: HELP
I can set reminders, check lists, or answer quick questions.
Set a nap reminder for 2pm.
Got it, I'll remind you for a nap at 2pm.

expected.agent_should: Return a short help menu and then process the follow-up request.

scenario: A scheduling question is resolved with no interruptions.

turns.text: Free for a quick call with alex@example.com on friday?
Looks free on Friday after 3pm. Want a slot?
Yes, 3:15pm works.
Booked for Friday at 3:15pm. I'll send a note.

expected.agent_should: Check availability and book the proposed time slot.

scenario: A summary request triggers a duplicate delivery alongside a follow-up.

turns.text: Summarize today's notes for me.
No new notes found for today.
duplicate webhook delivery of SMf7e902c86d414d59ac1e75b08df642c3
Add milk to the list.
Added milk to your grocery list.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate summary delivery while still processing the new request.

scenario: After opting out, an owner resumes contact with the agent to complete a simple task.

turns.text: START
carrier opt-in resume processed
Remind me to take the trash out tonight
Got it. I'll remind you to take the trash out tonight.

expected.agent_should: Re-enable messaging and set the requested reminder.

scenario: An owner provides a very long context to have the agent summarize their daily notes.

turns.text: Walked the dog, bought milk and bread, called about a bill, picked up a package, watered plants, fed the fish, and ran one errand across town. Can you summarize this?
Here's a summary: chores, groceries, a bill call, a pickup, and some errands.
Also note that the package was dropped off early and the bill has a due date on the last Friday of this month.
Updated: early package drop-off and the bill is due on the last Friday of this month.
Can you turn all of that into a one line reminder for tomorrow morning?
Reminder: finish errands, check the bill, and collect any follow-ups tomorrow morning.

expected.agent_should: Keep the full context across turns and return an accurate, condensed summary and reminder.

scenario: A message from a non allowlisted sender attempts to contact the agent.

turns.text: Can you tell me the owner's calendar for today?
message blocked: sender +15551234567 is not on the allowlist
I'm sorry, I can only respond to the owner of this number.

expected.agent_should: Block the message and send a short refusal without disclosing private details.

scenario: The agent receives a duplicate delivery of a scheduling request and processes it once.

turns.text: Schedule a 15 minute check in with Alex on example.com for Friday at 3 PM.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM85ac72e964f64c03a9d08f60cb175e41 ignored
Scheduled a 15 min check in with Alex for Friday at 3 PM.

expected.agent_should: Process the scheduling request only once and ignore the duplicate delivery.

scenario: An owner opts back in and receives help information before making a request.

turns.text: START
carrier opt-in resume processed
HELP
I can set reminders, answer questions, schedule, and take quick notes.
Set a reminder to call the vet at 9 AM
Got it. I'll remind you to call the vet at 9 AM.

expected.agent_should: Resume messaging, return help text, and process the follow up request.

scenario: An owner works through a multi-step task while correcting a small mistake.

turns.text: Quick question, how many cups in a quart?
There are 4 cups in a quart.
Thanks. Now schedule lunch with Morgan on example.com for Saturday at noon.
Scheduled lunch with Morgan for Saturday at noon.
Actually, make that 1 PM instead.
Updated to 1 PM for lunch with Morgan on Saturday.

expected.agent_should: Answer the quick question and correctly update the scheduled time.

scenario: The owner shares a happy update filled with emojis to see if the agent can interpret the tone.

turns.text: Just got the job offer today 🎉🥳 so excited!!
Congrats! That's huge. Want me to set a reminder to reply to their email by tomorrow?
Yes pls, thank you so much 😌
Got it. I'll remind you at 9 AM tomorrow.

expected.agent_should: Respond warmly to the emoji filled message and complete the reminder request.

scenario: A longer request is split into multiple SMS segments due to its length.

turns.text: Can you please make a list of things to grab for the picnic? I need chips, fruit cups, napkins, a big water jug, extra ice, paper plates, and sunscreen.
Also add bug spray and a trash bag if possible.
Got it. Picnic list: chips, fruit cups, napkins, water jug, ice, plates, sunscreen, bug spray, trash bag.
Perfect, thank you!
You're welcome! I'll keep it saved for today.

expected.agent_should: Combine both split segments into context and reply with the full compiled list.

scenario: The owner fires off a flurry of questions in rapid succession to test response timing.

turns.text: Is it raining?
Do I need a jacket?
How cold is it?
No rain right now. It's 65 degrees, so a light jacket should be enough!

expected.agent_should: Answer all rapid fire questions in one concise reply instead of three separate replies.

scenario: A duplicate webhook delivery is sent for an already processed message.

turns.text: Remind me to call the clinic at 3 PM.
Got it. I'll remind you to call the clinic at 3 PM today.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM6f576d4d833c4929935f5a7811d21be4
Already have that reminder set for 3 PM today.

expected.agent_should: Detect the duplicate delivery and only send a safe, idempotent follow up without re-creating the reminder.

scenario: The owner requests help with the service keywords.

turns.text: HELP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent
Help: I can set reminders, answer quick questions, or schedule tasks. Reply with what you need.
Actually just need a reminder to feed the fish tonight.
Got it. I'll remind you to feed the fish at 7 PM tonight.

scenario: The owner wants a quick summary of their upcoming tasks with no special edge cases.

turns.text: Any tasks for today?
You have 2 tasks: pick up groceries at 5 PM and feed the fish at 7 PM.
Nice, can you add one to water the plants?
Done. Water the plants added for 8 PM today.

expected.agent_should: Fetch a concise task summary and successfully add the requested task.

scenario: The owner attempts to schedule an appointment, but the replies arrive out of order.

turns.text: Book me a spot for a haircut.
Okay, which day works best?
connector reordering due to network delay for message SMca78be45f90642a094ea2c17f5d30896.
Anytime on Thursday.
out of order message reprocessed as SM701a5f84e8934079afdc280be726ecec (arriving after later context).
Prefer the morning slot.
Booked Thursday morning for a haircut.

expected.agent_should: Reorder the messages correctly and book the haircut for Thursday morning.

scenario: The owner sends a photo with no text and requires the agent to ask for context.

turns.text: media received with no text body.
MMS media only.
Looks like no text. What should I do with this image?
Save it to my grocery list receipt folder.
Need your approval to save this to receipts. Reply yes to confirm.
Yes.
Saved the receipt image to your grocery folder.

expected.agent_should: Prompt for context and an approval before saving media files.

scenario: The owner simply asks for a quick summary with no complications.

turns.text: Summarize my tasks for today.
You have one call and one pickup to complete today.
Thanks.
Anytime, let me know if anything changes.

expected.agent_should: Provide a concise summary and a brief follow up.

scenario: A purchase requires double approval while the connector reorders two of the messages.

turns.text: Buy more printer ink.
This will cost a small amount. Reply yes to approve.
connector reordering due to SMS delivery delay.
Priority shipping please.
Yes.
Ordered ink with priority shipping.

expected.agent_should: Reorder the requests, obtain explicit approval and place the order.

scenario: The owner sends only an image to set a reminder with no details.

turns.text: media received with no text body.
MMS media only.
No text found. When should I set a reminder for this?
Set it for tonight at 6.
Reminder set for tonight at 6.

expected.agent_should: Clarify the time for the reminder before setting it.

This will remove all future Fridays. Reply yes to confirm.
Yes.
All future Friday workouts have been cancelled.
One more question, do I still have credits?

Reminder set for 7pm to water the plants.

expected.agent_should: Retry the failed outbound SMS once before dropping the reply attempt.

turns.text: Meet me later
What time do you want to meet?
Around after lunch
Do you mean 1pm or 2pm?

expected.agent_should: Ask for clarification instead of guessing a specific time.

Your grocery list is eggs, bread, and milk.

scenario: A provider error occurs after a follow-up question and must be retried before finalizing a summary.

turns.text: Summarize notes for the project
Which project?
The one with the demo
provider error: 502 bad gateway while sending assistant reply
